per_view.notes: Slender tube with tapered nose and upswept tail cone. Partial front hump reads as a squarish box on the crown. Tall dark swept fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Engines form an indistinct grey cluster near the belly rather than four clear underwing nacelles on pylons. Nose gear and main bogies visible. Consistent window line; coherent grey/blue livery. Wings edge-on.

Slender white fuselage with front upper-deck hump, blue cheatline and tall swept dark-blue fin read as a 747. Windows dashed along deck. However the underwing area is a jumbled cluster: engines and main-gear wheels bunch together mid-body, individual nacelles indistinct, several parts appear to intersect. Nose gear present at right.

Head-on: four dark nacelles hung symmetrically under swept, slightly dihedral wings. Rounded crown/hump and blue vertical fin visible; thin horizontal stabilizers. Landing-gear wheel cluster under belly reads plausibly. Light-grey fuselage, grey engines, coherent. Cockpit/window detail minimal—only faint specks on the nose.

Head-on rear view: four dark nacelles hang two-per-side under swept wings with slight dihedral. Rounded grey fuselage with a crown bulge reading as the hump. Very thin dark-blue vertical fin (too slender), grey horizontal tailplane above wings. Central multi-bogie gear cluster looks cluttered. One cockpit window dot; almost no window/door lines.

Clean top-down: four cylindrical nacelles with dark inlets set forward of swept, tapered wings, two per side. Slender white fuselage with tapering nose and tail cone. Front upper-deck hump outline present. Tall fin plus swept tailplanes with blue centerline stripe. Faint dotted window lines. No floating parts.

Four underslung nacelles visible under swept tapering wings with dihedral. Slender tapering fuselage, tall dark-blue swept fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Front hump present but shallow and short, reads only weakly as the iconic 747 crown. Window line with blue cheat-stripe, nose and partial main gear visible. Coherent white/grey/navy livery, clean assembly.

Front hump with cockpit windows reads well; slender tapered fuselage, swept wings with dihedral, tall blue fin present. Engine nacelles cluster ambiguously near the belly rather than four clearly spaced underwing pods. Nose and main gear bogies visible but somewhat detached-looking. Coherent grey/white livery with dark window band.

Four underwing engines, swept wings with dihedral, nose+main gear visible. White fuselage, grey wings/engines, navy cockpit and belt stripe read coherently. Window band and cockpit windows present. Upper hump sits too far aft mid-fuselage and reads as a raised block rather than the iconic nose-blended 747 crown, weakening the silhouette.
